snippet.title: Dev Blog #5 — Behind the Scenes: Building the Montenotte Map
snippet.description:
Link to Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4202430/Veterans_Napoleonic_Wars/ 

Our DEVBLOG #5 is here! Take a closer look at how we build our maps, and see the reworked Montenotte - more open, more space for tactics, and a redoubt that is now a real objective.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Take command of the 19th-century battlefield. Veterans: Napoleonic Wars is an intense real-time battle simulator that puts you in the boots of a frontline general. There is no need to establish a base, do only what you want to and focus on thousands of soldiers awaiting your orders, and the smell of black powder in the air.
